decision.reason: The only evidence, [ev-4555b462d2c6], is a one-line changelog commit title: "do not normalize resource tracking on live crds", a cherry-pick of #22722. It does not say which tracking mechanism or component is involved (subject), what the wrong normalization did, or which setups hit it (for example a particular tracking method or CRDs managed by Argo CD) (applicability). It also doesn't say what an exposed environment experienced (consequence). Answering those needs the PR #22722/#22735 description or a linked issue.
